svg.title: Mesolabe paper exploration: 2 times the volume
svg.desc: Print landscape at actual size, verify the 25 millimetre bar, cut the two lower squares, and place them in the upper frame. Keep the middle square fixed. Left plate goes above it, right below. Physical fabrication and printer scaling are unverified.
svg.text: A modern paper exploration of the construction transmitted by Eutocius, Heiberg 1881, pp.106-113.
Hold both moving panels between the guides. All diagonals slope the same way.
Align a straightedge from A through both exposed contacts B, G to D. Read G's height above the lower guide.
For an original edge of 1 unit, divide that height by 30 mm. Cube this ratio to check the volume.
Cut dashed outlines only. Make a slit at the middle panel's upper and lower edges if needed to pass the right panel below it.
Print at 100%, without fit-to-page. This is not a groove fabrication plan; physical assembly and accuracy are unverified.
svg.metadata: MIT, Anton Soloviev, 2026. Source: https://www.wilbourhall.org/pdfs/Archimedes_VOL_III.pdf. Equal squares and 60 mm dimensions are modern choices.
